verdict: Paid ads paused Sep 17; funnel infrastructure is being verified before restart.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 66 leads entirely from Meta at a cost per lead of $16.65 — but all paid spend stopped on September 17, and no new leads have come in since September 16. Google Ads ran $267.95 in spend over the period and produced zero conversions, so that budget has been paused while conversion tracking is brought up to standard. Before any campaigns restart, we are completing verification of your payment paths, conversion signals, and landing pages — all of which are overdue and must be confirmed to ensure spend works as intended. Your Google Business Profile continued generating organic interest (46 actions this period), and site traffic held steady through the pause, which is a healthy sign for your organic presence. Once the infrastructure checks are complete, paid campaigns will relaunch on a verified foundation, and you should see lead volume resume in the coming weeks.
